title: The Price of Choice in Selective Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.29067v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A selective classifier may be claimed to satisfy a risk-coverage contract if some rule from a predeclared menu (a threshold or a union of $K$ score intervals) attains coverage at least $\kappa$ and error at most $\alpha$. Refuting this existential claim requires ruling out every permitted rule. The intersection-union test (IUT) achieves validity without a multiplicity correction, but its sample cost can increase with menu richness. We characterize this cost and compare it with the optimal audit. For a fixed interior risk target $\alpha$ and gap $\gamma$, the minimax sample size for K-interval menus at coverage floor $\kappa$ is $K(1-\kappa)/(\kappa\gamma^2)$, up to logarithmic factors, in the stated small-gap, large-menu regime; exact IUT attains this rate. The lower bound holds even with a known score distribution, while the upper bound extends to menus of VC dimension $d$. Procedures that refuse to reject whenever any rule appears feas

translated_title: 选择性预测中选择的代价
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.29067v1 公告类型: new 摘要：如果预先声明的规则菜单（一个阈值或K个分数区间的并集）中的某条规则能够达到至少κ的覆盖率且错误率至多为α，则可宣称该选择性分类器满足风险-覆盖契约。要驳斥这一存在性断言，需要排除所有被允许的规则。交并测试（IUT）无需多重性校正即可实现有效性，但其样本成本可能随菜单的丰富程度而增加。我们刻画了这一成本，并将其与最优审计进行比较。对于固定的内部风险目标α和间隙γ，在所述的小间隙、大菜单情形下，当覆盖下限为κ时，K区间菜单的极小极大样本量为K(1-κ)/(κγ²)（忽略对数因子）；精确的IUT可达到这一速率。该下界即使在分数分布已知的情况下依然成立，而上界可扩展至VC维为d的菜单。当任何规则看似可行时都拒绝拒绝（即不拒绝）的程序……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文刻画了选择性预测中审计“存在满足风险-覆盖契约的规则”这一断言时的代价：交并测试（IUT）所需的极小极大样本量随允许规则数K线性增长，且该速率在忽略对数因子的意义下是最优的。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the price of choice in selective prediction, showing that auditing an existential risk-coverage claim via the intersection-union test incurs a minimax sample size growing linearly with the number of permitted rules K, and this rate is optimal up to logarithmic factors.
